# Skills

<!-- Generated by tools/build_catalog.py - do not edit by hand. -->

122 skills in 32 categories. Every skill is a standard Agent Skill and works in Claude Code, Google Antigravity, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex and Gemini CLI. Install a category with `python tools/install.py --agent <agent> --plugin <category>`; see the [main README](../README.md#install) for every option.

## Folder layout

A skill lives in `skills/<area>/<group>/<skill>/`. The area and group only organise the source: a skill is still installed, and named, by its own folder name. The sections after this table list the skills by category (plugin), which is what you install.
